title: Synthesis, evaluation of in vitro cytotoxic activity, and in silico studies of some 3-methylenamino-4(3H)-quinazolone derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,29864-29878
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03933A, Paper
Open Access

Tuyen Ngoc Truong, Em Canh Pham, Ngoc-Vi Nguyen Tran, Phu Thien Tieu, My Hanh Thi Cao, Tuoi Thi Hong Do, Khanh N. B. Le
Twenty 3-methylenamino-4(3H)-quinazolone derivatives were synthesized via imine formation. Compounds 5, 6, and 7 showed potent cytotoxicity against RD and MDA-MB-231, low toxicity to normal cells, and strong EGFR binding, with good ADMET profiles.
